import sys
from bisect import bisect_left

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    it = iter(data)
    N = next(it)
    F = next(it)

    monsters = [next(it) for _ in range(N)]
    powers = [next(it) for _ in range(F)]
    bonuses = [next(it) for _ in range(F)]

    fairies = sorted(zip(powers, bonuses), reverse=True)
    monsters.sort()

    defeated = 0

    for power, bonus in fairies:
        idx = bisect_left(monsters, power)
        take = min(bonus, idx)
        if take > 0:
            del monsters[idx - take:idx]
            defeated += take

    print(defeated)

if __name__ == "__main__":
